FetchContent_Declare(
        libnri
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/NRI.git
        GIT_TAG v180
)

set(NRI_STATIC_LIBRARY ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_STREAMER_THREAD_SAFE ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_ENABLE_AMDAGS OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_ENABLE_NVAPI OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_ENABLE_NVTX_SUPPORT OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_ENABLE_WGPU_SUPPORT OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(NRI_ENABLE_IMGUI_EXTENSION OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
if (${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} STREQUAL "Windows")
    set(NRI_ENABLE_AGILITY_SDK_SUPPORT ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
    set(NRI_ENABLE_D3D12_SUPPORT ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
    set(NRI_ENABLE_D3D11_SUPPORT OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
endif ()
if (${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(NRI_ENABLE_XLIB_SUPPORT OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
    set(NRI_ENABLE_WAYLAND_SUPPORT ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
endif ()

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(libnri)
